name: Azd
description:
Azure DevOps pull requests integration.

Based on Jetbrains GitHub/GitLab plugins, AZD will streamline your development with Azure DevOps.

AZD plugin integrates with both Azure DevOps Service and Azure DevOps Server (versions: 2020 or 2022).

Connect to your Azure DevOps account with a PAT and bring Azure DevOps features directly into your IDE.

Features

  • 🚀Active Pull Requests: Get an overview of all your active pull requests.
  • 🚀Superior Code Review: Review code using your IDE's advanced syntax highlighting and code insight features.
  • 🚀Manage Pull Requests: Seamlessly create, approve, or reject pull requests without switching context.
  • 🚀Collaboration Tools: Engage in discussions, leave comments, and collaborate with your team.
  • 🚀Pipelines Tools: Run and monitor pipelines directly from your IDE.
  • 🚀Pipelines Tests: Get a detailed overview of your pipeline tests and analyze test results, logs, and stack traces.
  • 🚀Pipelines YAML: Get code completion and validation for Azure DevOps Pipelines YAML schema.
  • 🚀Pipeline Approvals: Approve, reject, or defer pipeline approvals (Environment and ManualValidation@1) from the pipeline view.
  • 🚀AI-Powered PR Titles: Generate meaningful pull request titles automatically based on your changes.
  • 🚀AI-Generated PR Descriptions: Create comprehensive pull request descriptions with a single click.
  • 🚀AI Code Review: Review pull requests with AI chat assistance to identify issues and improvements.
  • 🚀Smart Commit Messages: Generate contextual commit messages that accurately describe your code changes.
